name: nogomet
description: Nogomet app za prijavo za rekereacijo ob torkih nogomet
author: Nik Perne <nik.perne@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm install && cd angular && npm run build
scripts.import:db-docker: docker cp ./data/kulturne-dediscine.json web-dev-mongo-db:/kulturne-dediscine.json; docker cp ./data/testni-uporabniki.json web-dev-mongo-db:/testni-uporabniki.json; docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db mongoimport --db Demo --collection Locations --mode upsert --upsertFields id --jsonArray --file kulturne-dediscine.json;  docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db mongoimport --db Demo --collection Users --mode upsert --upsertFields email --jsonArray --file testni-uporabniki.json; docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db rm -rf kulturne-dediscine.json
scripts.delete:db-docker: docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "mongosh Demo --eval 'db.Locations.deleteMany({})'; mongosh Demo --eval 'db.Users.deleteMany({})'"
scripts.view:db-docker: docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "mongosh Demo --eval 'db.Locations.find()'; mongosh Demo --eval 'db.Users.find()'"
scripts.transfer:db-docker-atlas: docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "mongodump -h localhost -d Demo -o ./"; docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "mongorestore --drop --uri mongodb+srv://app@demo.548y4py.mongodb.net ./Demo/Locations.bson"; docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "mongorestore --drop --uri mongodb+srv://app@demo.548y4py.mongodb.net ./Demo/Users.bson"; docker exec -it web-dev-mongo-db bash -c "rm -rf ./Demo"
